summary: Full E2E testing of Datamosh Technologies site. 15/15 backend pytest tests passed. All frontend flows verified: home, mega-menu (8 cards), service category & detail pages, industries (12), about, resources (3), careers (6 jobs + filter + apply modal), contact form, newsletter, and mobile menu. No console errors. Minor testability gap: form input fields in Contact and Apply modal lack data-testid attributes (only the form wrappers/submit buttons do).

minor.issue: Returns 200 OK on successful create; spec usually expects 201 Created for resource creation. Same for /api/newsletter and /api/careers/apply.
Accepts any 'role' string (the early job-id check is a no-op due to 'pass'). Open applications are allowed by design, but invalid role strings are silently stored without validation.
Lists all contacts publicly without authentication — fine for MVP but should be protected before production.

issues: No critical issues; layout/contrast/typography render correctly with deep navy + orange accents

action_items: Add data-testid to form input fields in ContactPage Field component (e.g., contact-name, contact-email, contact-message, contact-company, contact-phone) — currently only the wrapper form and submit button have testids; tests must rely on input[name=...]
Add data-testid to inputs inside the Careers apply modal (apply-name, apply-email, apply-phone, apply-experience, apply-linkedin, apply-cover-letter) — same reason
Consider returning 201 for successful POST creates on /api/contact, /api/newsletter, /api/careers/apply
Add validation for /api/careers/apply role field (currently 'if not any(...): pass' — dead code)
Protect GET /api/contact behind auth before production deploy
critical_code_review_comments: Pydantic v2 used correctly with ConfigDict; EmailStr validation works as expected (422 returned).
Mongo _id correctly excluded via projection {'_id': 0} in list_contacts and newsletter lookup.
Dead code in apply_career: the 'if not any(...): pass' block has no effect — either enforce role validation or remove the block.
Newsletter idempotency works as designed (same email returns existing record).
Frontend correctly uses process.env.REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL and the /api prefix on all calls.
Form components reuse a shared Field/Input that does not forward data-testid — adding a testid prop would improve testability without refactoring callers.
test_credentials: N/A — public marketing site, no auth required
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_-prefixed contact, newsletter (test_news_*), and career application records via API and UI flows. JOBS list is static (6 entries) in server.py.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend URL: https://nexus-enterprise-ai-1.preview.emergentagent.com. Backend regression file: /app/backend/tests/test_datamosh_api.py (15 tests, all passing). Frontend form inputs (Contact + Apply modal) currently lack data-testid on the actual <input>/<textarea> elements — playwright tests should use input[name="..."] selectors as a workaround until E1 adds testids. All flows are wired correctly and persist to MongoDB collections: contacts, newsletter, applications.
rca of the issue: N/A — no blocking issues. The only testability gap (missing data-testid on form fields) is documented above.
